context_stem: A Risk Report will document the following:
excerpt: Additional relevant factors: Any other considerations material to our risk analysis.
paraphrase: Any other material considerations relevant to the risk analysis will also be included.

excerpt: Risk analyses. We will provide our reasoning and conclusions regarding both specific threat models and overall risk levels.
paraphrase: The Risk Report will present reasoning and conclusions on both specific threat models and overall risk levels.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: First, we will compile a Capability Report that documents the findings from the comprehensive assessment, makes an affirmative case for why the Capability Threshold is sufficiently far away, and advances recommendations on deployment decisions.

paraphrase: Lead-in sentence introducing the list of analysis components.

excerpt: Threat-specific risk assessment: For each threat model, we will analyze remaining absolute risk–i.e., the leftover risk after accounting for our mitigations.
paraphrase: For each threat model, the remaining absolute risk after mitigations will be analyzed.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Below, we specify the Capability Thresholds and their corresponding Required Safeguards. The Required Safeguards for each Capability Threshold are intended to mitigate risk from a model with such capabilities to acceptable levels.

excerpt: We will also discuss whether we believe we've crossed relevant thresholds in our recommendations for industry-wide safety (see Section 1), and (as relevant) whether we believe we're meeting the risk mitigation standards corresponding to them.
paraphrase: The report will also discuss whether relevant safety thresholds have been crossed and whether corresponding mitigation standards are being met.

excerpt: Overall risk assessment: We will provide an overall risk assessment.
paraphrase: An overall risk assessment will be provided.

excerpt: Risk-benefit determination: We will explain whether, and if so why, we believe the identified risks are justified by corresponding benefits.
paraphrase: The report will explain whether and why identified risks are considered justified by corresponding benefits.

excerpt: Looking forward: We will outline our plans for continuing to monitor and mitigate the relevant risks over time.
paraphrase: Plans for continued monitoring and mitigation of risks over time will be outlined.

excerpt: Review of past Risk Reports and decisions. We will address:
paraphrase: Lead-in sentence introducing the list of topics addressed under review of past Risk Reports and decisions.

context_stem: Review of past Risk Reports and decisions. We will address:
excerpt: Changes in risk mitigation practices—noteworthy cases in which our risk mitigation practices deviated (including temporarily) or changed from what we discussed in our previous Risk Report over the relevant period, and their implications for the overall level of risk.
paraphrase: Noteworthy deviations or changes in risk mitigation practices since the previous Risk Report, and their risk implications, will be addressed.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: We will also periodically release information on internal reports of potential instances of non-compliance and other implementation challenges we encounter.

context_stem: Review of past Risk Reports and decisions. We will address:
excerpt: Decisions to internally deploy in-scope models that would not otherwise be reviewed in a Risk Report (because they happened in between Risk Reports).
paraphrase: Decisions to internally deploy in-scope models between Risk Reports, which would otherwise go unreviewed, will be addressed.

context_stem: Review of past Risk Reports and decisions. We will address:
excerpt: We will discuss how these decisions were made and whether they appear reasonable in light of any noteworthy new information that has come to light since then.
paraphrase: The report will discuss how such internal deployment decisions were made and whether they remain reasonable given new information.

context_stem: Review of past Risk Reports and decisions. We will address:
excerpt: Changes to our Frontier Safety Roadmap and any cases where we failed to meet our goals.
paraphrase: Changes to the Frontier Safety Roadmap and any instances of failing to meet stated goals will be addressed.

excerpt: Marginal risk and ecosystem analysis. If we determine that the absolute level of risk being imposed industry-wide by AI systems such as ours is high, and are justifying our decision to move forward based partly on a marginal risk analysis, we will additionally address the following:
paraphrase: If high industry-wide absolute risk is determined and a marginal risk analysis partly justifies moving forward, additional topics will be addressed.

context_stem: Marginal risk and ecosystem analysis: we will additionally address the following:
excerpt: Competitive landscape analysis: What we know about how our current and future model capabilities and risk mitigations compare to those of relevant competitors.
paraphrase: The analysis will address knowledge about how current and future model capabilities and mitigations compare to competitors.
